summary: Tested VIP subscription plan feature (backend + landing page frontend) and cross-store savings regression. Backend: 10/12 passed, 2 skipped (per-IP payment rate-limit budget). Landing page pricing section and subscribe page URL-param preselection verified. Plan-selector UI past OTP step could not be automated due to live Cloudflare Turnstile (not sandbox test mode). Fixed a Motor DB truth-testing bug in security.py that was causing 500 errors during rate-limit paths.

minor.issue: Rate-limit of 4/hour per IP is very tight for test automation — blocked 4th parametrized plan test. Functional, but makes full e2e suites flaky. Consider raising to 10/hour or exempting sandbox/trusted IPs.

integration_issues.issue: Cloudflare Turnstile site key 0x4AAAAAAC5Kc8juEeONfiUI is a live (non-test) widget, so Send-OTP button stays disabled until a real human solves the checkbox. Main agent's brief said it would auto-pass in sandbox. This blocks automated testing of everything after the OTP step (plan-selector, upgrade-to-vip banner, payment flow).

action_items: Swap REACT_APP_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY to Cloudflare's documented test site key 1x00000000000000000000AA (always passes) for preview/sandbox envs, so the OTP step can be automated end-to-end; keep the real key for production.
Consider raising /api/payment/create-order rate limit from 4/hour to 10/hour, or allow sandbox bypass, to make e2e tests deterministic.

Agent-to-agent note to main agent: the plan-selector/upgrade-banner UI itself has NOT been exercised in a browser — only the URL-param preselection side-effect (sidebar price) was confirmed. Recommend self-test with a real browser (click captcha, verify OTP, confirm plan radio cards + dynamic Pay button).
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: /app/backend/security.py had three Motor/AsyncIOMotorDatabase instances tested with `if self._db:` / `if not self._db:` — PyMongo/Motor raises NotImplementedError on bool(db). Converted to `is not None` / `is None`. Was causing a 500 response whenever the rate-limiter fired on any endpoint (e.g., 4th payment create-order call returned 500 instead of a proper 429).
Subscribe page still depends on live Turnstile in preview env — consider env-gated test site key.

/api/payment/create-order requires name/email/address/dob even before showing plan UI — this is fine, but the create-order → verify rate limit is shared so e2e tests that do create+verify twice may trip rate limiter unexpectedly.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed tests passed (10 passed, 2 skipped due to rate-limit budget — but vip_yearly create-order + verify was run standalone and passed)
success_rate.frontend: Landing pricing section 100%; Subscribe URL-param preselection confirmed; plan-selector UI past OTP: NOT TESTED (captcha blocker)

test_credentials: Same as /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Fresh phones 9876543253-9876543258 used for new signups. 9876543251 upgraded to VIP yearly during test — no longer 'fresh'.
seed_data_creation: Subscriber 9876543251 was promoted to VIP yearly (tier=vip, plan=vip_yearly, expiresAt ~365 days) during the verify-flow test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/plans is the canonical source of truth; all 4 plan amounts verified. The Turnstile live-mode blocker for subscribe-page automation will persist until main agent swaps REACT_APP_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY to the Cloudflare test key in the preview env. For future e2e runs, space out /api/payment/create-order calls (≤4/hour/IP) or restart backend to reset the in-memory rate limiter.
rca_of_the_issue: security.py used `if self._db:` / `if security_tracker._db:` truth-tests on a Motor AsyncIOMotorDatabase, which raises NotImplementedError. That triggered a 500 response in rate_limit_exceeded_handler whenever the payment endpoint's per-IP limit was hit (masking what should be a 429). Fixed by switching to `is not None` / `is None` comparisons in all three occurrences.
